label: APC Network Management Card 3 (UPS NMC)
description: SmartSlot network management card for APC Smart-UPS/SRT units that publishes UPS state, runs battery self-tests and scheduled shutdowns, and exposes SNMP, Modbus TCP and BACnet/IP to a monitoring system. One 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 uplink connects it to the network; the two USB-A ports are for firmware/Wi-Fi dongle and the micro-USB port is a local console, so neither is a network port.
